label: fed-back p early in the copy phase (mostly copy step 1, after first token p), output-dependent
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase when the input is the fed-back token p (100% of activations have in_tok=p), almost always within the first copy steps: recall_idx 1 holds 88% of mass (i.e. prev input <DEL>, first original token p), recall_idx 2 holds 11%, never later. Never fires in the original or delimiter phase, or on any other input token. It is selective: only ~16% of p-inputs at copy step 1 fire; firing depends strongly on the token being output (out_tok y 12x lift, r 8x, p, d, k, 2 ~4-6x; others weak), and rate rises with longer sequences (more outputs to go). Strongest activations are p at copy step 1 with out_tok y/r/2 in L>=7 sequences. Predicate restricting out_tok to {y,r,p,d,k,2} gets dev F1 ~0.41, mass recall ~0.76; the broad envelope (copy phase & input p & recall_idx<=2) has recall 0.99 but precision 0.09.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: recall_idx=1 & in_tok=p (+4.76), phase=2 & out_tok=r (+3.40), recall_idx=2 & in_tok=p (+3.23), phase=2 & in_tok=p (+2.71), phase=2 & out_tok=p (+2.67), phase=2 & out_tok=y (+2.51). Lower it: next_out=- (-2.02), orig4=u (-1.98), orig3=u (-1.96), out_tok=z (-1.96).
